1.w: I am the man who has experienced affliction from the rod of the Lord’s wrath.

2.w: He drove me into captivity and made me walk in darkness and not light.

3.w: He repeatedly attacks me; he turns his hand against me all day long. ב (Bet)

4.w: He has made my mortal skin waste away; he has broken my bones.

5.w: He has besieged and surrounded me with bitter hardship.

6.w: He has made me reside in deepest darkness like those who died long ago. ג (Gimel)

7.w: He has walled me in so that I cannot get out; he has weighted me down with heavy prison chains.

8.w: Also, when I cry out desperately for help, he has shut out my prayer.

9.w: He has blocked every road I take with a wall of hewn stones; he has made every path impassable. ד (Dalet)

10.w: To me he is like a bear lying in ambush, like a hidden lion stalking its prey.

11.w: He has obstructed my paths and torn me to pieces; he has made me desolate.

12.w: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrow. ה (He)

13.w: He shot his arrows into my heart.

14.w: I have become the laughingstock of all people, their mocking song all day long.

15.w: He has given me my fill of bitter herbs and made me drunk with bitterness. ו (Vav)

16.w: He ground my teeth in gravel; he trampled me in the dust.

17.w: I am deprived of peace; I have forgotten what happiness is.

18.w: So I said, “My endurance has expired; I have lost all hope of deliverance from the Lord.” ז (Zayin)

19.w: Remember my impoverished and homeless condition, which is a bitter poison.

20.w: I continually think about this, and I am depressed.

21.w: But this I call to mind; therefore I have hope: ח (Khet)

22.w: The Lord’s loyal kindness never ceases; his compassions never end.

23.w: They are fresh every morning; your faithfulness is abundant!

24.w: “My portion is the Lord,” I have said to myself, so I will put my hope in him. ט (Tet)

25.w: The Lord is good to those who trust in him, to the one who seeks him.

26.w: It is good to wait patiently for deliverance from the Lord.

27.w: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young. י (Yod)

28.w: Let a person sit alone in silence, when the Lord is disciplining him.

29.w: Let him bury his face in the dust; perhaps there is hope.

30.w: Let him offer his cheek to the one who hits him; let him have his fill of insults. כ (Kaf)

31.w: For the Lord will not reject us forever.

32.w: Though he causes us grief, he then has compassion on us according to the abundance of his loyal kindness.

33.w: For he is not predisposed to afflict or to grieve people. ל (Lamed)

34.w: To crush underfoot all the earth’s prisoners,

35.w: to deprive a person of his rights in the presence of the Most High,

36.w: to defraud a person in a lawsuit— the Lord does not approve of such things! מ (Mem)

37.w: Whose command was ever fulfilled unless the Lord decreed it?

38.w: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that everything comes— both calamity and blessing?

39.w: Why should any living person complain when punished for his sins? נ (Nun)

40.w: Let us carefully examine our ways, and let us return to the Lord.

41.w: Let us lift up our hearts and our hands to God in heaven:

42.w: “We have blatantly rebelled; you have not forgiven.” ס (Samek)

43.w: You shrouded yourself with anger and then pursued us; you killed without mercy.

44.w: You shrouded yourself with a cloud so that no prayer could get through.

45.w: You make us like filthy scum in the estimation of the nations. פ (Pe)

46.w: All our enemies have gloated over us;

47.w: panic and pitfall have come upon us, devastation and destruction.

48.w: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed. ע (Ayin)

49.w: Tears flow from my eyes and will not stop; there will be no break

50.w: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees what has happened.

51.w: What my eyes see grieves me — all the suffering of the daughters in my city. צ (Tsade)

52.w: For no good reason my enemies hunted me down like a bird.

53.w: They shut me up in a pit and threw stones at me.

54.w: The waters closed over my head; I thought I was about to die. ק (Qof)

55.w: I have called on your name, O Lord, from the deepest pit.

56.w: You heard my plea: “Do not close your ears to my cry for relief!”

57.w: You came near on the day I called to you; you said, “Do not fear!” ר (Resh)

58.w: O Lord, you championed my cause; you redeemed my life.

59.w: You have seen the wrong done to me, O Lord; pronounce judgment on my behalf!

60.w: You have seen all their vengeance, all their plots against me. ש (Sin/Shin)

61.w: You have heard their taunts, O Lord, all their plots against me.

62.w: My assailants revile and conspire against me all day long.

63.w: Watch them from morning to evening; I am the object of their mocking songs. ת (Tav)

64.w: Pay them back what they deserve, O Lord, according to what they have done.

65.w: Give them a distraught heart; may your curse be on them!

66.w: Pursue them in anger and eradicate them from under the Lord’s heaven. א (Alef)
